# QS-CFW-3173-95 — Quality specification - gear blank CFW-3173-95 (8620)
Revision: Rev E  
Supersedes: Rev D  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-3173-95

Scope
This specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection requirements for gear blank CFW-3173-95 (CFW-3173-95) manufactured at Plant P1. Applies to raw-forged blanks delivered for downstream machining and heat treatment operations. Nonconformance handling and disposition rules for deviations from this document are included.

Requirements table

| Feature | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 8620 |
| Hardness range | 37-43 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.03 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 125.8 kg |
| Surface condition | Free of cracks, laps, and crush defects affecting fit or machining |
| Identification | Part number legibly stamped or tag attached |

Inspection method
- Visual inspection: Verify surface condition and identification against the Requirements table. Use magnification or dye-penetrant if visual indications suggest subsurface discontinuities.
- Hardness: Verify hardness range on representative locations using a calibrated portable HRC tester. Report readings and locations. Ensure values fall within 37-43 HRC.
- Dimensional: Measure bore diameter at specified inspection points. Report deviation relative to the nominal bore and confirm compliance with ±0.03 mm tolerance.
- Weight: Confirm the forging does not exceed the maximum forging weight of 125.8 kg. Use calibrated scales for verification.
- Sampling: Inspect items against the Requirements table prior to release for machining. Retain inspection records with lot traceability.

Nonconformance handling
- Any deviation from the Requirements table shall be documented on a nonconformance record. Parts outside 37-43 HRC, outside ±0.03 mm bore tolerance, or exceeding 125.8 kg are nonconforming.
- Nonconforming material shall be segregated and labeled. Disposition options: rework, use-as-is with documented engineering approval, or scrap. Engineering approval must reference this document and the specific nonconformance.
- Records: Maintain inspection reports and nonconformance records in the document control system for traceability.
